meta.label: GDP per capita, by NUTS 3 region (2023)
meta.methodNote: GDP per inhabitant in current-price euros (not purchasing-power-adjusted — a PPS-per-capita figure would rank differently, since a euro buys more in Albania than in Ireland), per NUTS 3 region (province-equivalent), Eurostat's own nama_10r_3gdp dataset, 2023, the newest year with Italy (2024 has none; year reviewed 2026-10-03). Boundaries: github.com/eurostat/Nuts2json, 2021 typology. A handful of regions (Ireland's IE053 and IE061, small German districts) are genuine multinational-tax-accounting outliers, not local prosperity — the map's color scale excludes them from setting its range without excluding them from the map (see components/EuropeMapExplorer.tsx's computeDomain()).
meta.coverageNote: The UK has no NUTS 3 GDP figure for any year — absent from Eurostat's own geo dimension entirely, not merely missing a value (a different, more total gap than the population layer's "historical only"). Albania, Norway and Switzerland have no NUTS 3 figure for 2023 and show as no data, never as zero.
